item.content:
Project 1 brief; theme introduction; precedents; sketching and prototyping in chipboard; the crit protocol.

Ideas

Iteration and prototyping culture; design intent vs. fabrication constraint; reading precedents technically (how was it made?).

In class

  • Brief + precedents (40 min)
  • crit protocol (20 min)
  • sketch/prototype work (90 min)
